# ANet DSH Bundle > 为 DSH 操作者将本机 anet 节点接到 MCP 与 Skill，以统一可执行路径和身份发现对端、委派任务并跟踪结果。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[ANetResearch/ANet](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet) - **版本号**：0.3.0（[固定提交 6dc9b6793e46d3a630c9836349e5ca635d4ef761](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet/tree/6dc9b6793e46d3a630c9836349e5ca635d4ef761)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-27（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定组件目录较旧基线无变仍完整复核，薄集成与安装分支可核；未完整审节点/远端payload或运行。先观察、禁自动装并审拟用运行时/政策后界定受控小样。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：为已有跨节点委派需求的操作者，把同一 anet 路径/身份接入 DSH 的 MCP 和 Skill。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：显式路径/identity与运行时指南减少MCP/CLI分叉，安装锁/日志改善并发诊断，不证明节点协议/付费安全。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **思考**：固定bundle不固定HTTPS动态installer/binary/guide，提示不等入站/支付控制，900秒等安装不取消后台。见[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：未验证方向为任务绑定binary/guide/identity/政策收据，已有resolve诊断之上新增版本失效和结果关联，用版本×政策对照否定。见[Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：观察优先，操作者先关闭自动装并固定审阅运行时/guide/身份/节点政策，才确定非敏感无消费小样；版本/政策不明或任务/worker仍未知先停扩张并核状态。见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 核心贡献 显式路径/identity与运行时指南减少MCP/CLI分叉，安装锁/日志改善并发诊断，不证明节点协议/付费安全。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 关键质疑 固定bundle不固定HTTPS动态installer/binary/guide，提示不等入站/支付控制，900秒等安装不取消后台。见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证方向为任务绑定binary/guide/identity/政策收据，已有resolve诊断之上新增版本失效和结果关联，用版本×政策对照否定。见[Q05](#research-q05)。 后续先以无网络假binary核路径/env/多挂载/安装状态；外部真实安装/节点政策、对端任务和消费在固定审阅与授权范围内另验。 ## 场景与替代办法 为已有跨节点委派需求的操作者，把同一 anet 路径/身份接入 DSH 的 MCP 和 Skill。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 直接anet CLI或手配受控MCP；网络/加密/结算归节点，bundle增量在接线和指南一致。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 依赖与流程 DSH/MCP、shell/PowerShell、外部anet与策略/对端按操作需要；表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 先禁自动装审版本/策略，再核路径/身份/guide、节点和非敏感任务；失败先查实际状态再重试；步骤见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 成本与效果 节点/身份/对端与可能定价任务、版本维护及后台恢复负担未知，非15分钟交付保证；表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 路径/方法一致与安装诊断有实现，跨节点交付率、加密/费用与净人工收益未独立验证；效果见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：薄bundle固定了什么，外部安装/节点/指南和任务结果还需什么证据？ ### Q01 · 实际bundle相对CLI/MCP增加什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 组件dsh-anet 0.3.0是DSH原生bundle：patch插anetPlugin设置服务、skills注册和官方dsh-mcp-client stdio节点。目标是已有明确跨机器/跨组织委派需求的操作者，从DSH发现对端、发任务/跟踪结果及处理本机收到的任务。合格结果须任务内容获授权、对端身份正确、实际交付可验和预算受控，节点在线/MCP连上不算任务办结。 基线是直接装anet CLI，或自行配置受控MCP与运行指南。bundle实际增量在同一个路径/identity供MCP和Skill命令使用、Skill包目录替换、运行时自带guide避免复制漂移和DSH长调用预算。A2A、端到端加密、hub转发、定价结算归外部anet节点/协议，不是薄bundle新算法或研究已验证的安全能力。 与旧固定基线5b931b2d…比较，当前组件目录git树diff为空；本轮仍独立重读集成/runner/安装和Skill链。四准备材料身份/revision/内容摘要核准，SOURCE候选只根README不等组件源码不存在；已用git tracked及固定git show补读Windows脚本。固定bundle可复现适配代码，但不能仅据它复现自动下载的运行时/guide/网络对端。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[deploy/plugins/dist/dsh/package.json:1-15](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet/blob/6dc9b6793e46d3a630c9836349e5ca635d4ef761/deploy/plugins/dist/dsh/package.json#L1-L15) 组件身份和作者能力描述。
查看原文（15行） ```text { "name": "dsh-anet", "version": "0.3.0", "description": "Delegate tasks to other AI agents over A2A through a local AgentNetwork (anet) node: find agents, send and track end-to-end encrypted tasks, settle priced skills within operator limits, and answer tasks sent to this node. Enabling the plugin installs anet with the official signed installer, starts its node and joins the public hub; set ANET_PLUGIN_NO_INSTALL=1 to turn the installation off.", "license": "Apache-2.0", "author": "Agent Network Research (https://agentnetwork.org.cn)", "homepage": "https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/", "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "git+https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet.git", "directory": "deploy/plugins/dist/dsh" }, "keywords": [ "dsh-plugin", "deepseek-harness", ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[deploy/plugins/dist/dsh/package.json:36-44](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet/blob/6dc9b6793e46d3a630c9836349e5ca635d4ef761/deploy/plugins/dist/dsh/package.json#L36-L44) DSH引擎与bundle入口。 ```text "engines": { "dsh": ">=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0" }, "dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } } } ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[deploy/plugins/dist/dsh/cordis.patch.yml:4-24](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet/blob/6dc9b6793e46d3a630c9836349e5ca635d4ef761/deploy/plugins/dist/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L4-L24) 真实设置/Skill/MCP节点与长超时。

      "content": "# anet\n\n[中文文档](./README_CN.md)\n\nConnects DeepSeek Harness to AgentNetwork (anet), so that the agent in a DeepSeek Harness session can hand work to other AI agents over the [A2A protocol](https://a2a-protocol.org) and answer tasks that other agents send to this machine.\n\nEnabling the plugin installs anet: when its MCP server starts and finds no anet on the machine, it runs the official installer, which checks the signed release manifest and the SHA-256 of the download, installs anet for the user, starts its node and joins the public hub `https://hub.agentnetwork.org.cn`. No further step is needed. The installation can be turned off (see \"Automatic installation\" below).\n\nanet is an open-source node that runs on the user's machine. It holds the agent's identity, encrypts every message end to end, and exchanges tasks with other nodes through a hub. The hub relays messages and cannot read them. anet runs no model: the agents at either end do the work. Priced skills are settled with [a2a-x402](https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/a2a-x402) within limits that only the operator sets.\n\n## What the plugin provides\n\n| Component | Name | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| MCP server | `anet` | The tools of `anet mcp`, served by the anet installed on this machine. Its tool `guide` returns the current guide to anet. The launcher installs anet when it is missing, and `anet mcp` starts the node when it is not running. |\n| Skill | `anet` | Tells the agent to read the guide of the installed anet before the first anet action of a session and on every \"@anet\" request, and holds the rules that always apply. Loaded when the user writes \"@anet\", mentions anet, AgentNetwork or an AID, or wants to hand work to other agents. |\n| Skill | `anet-status` | Shows the state of the node, as the guide of the installed anet describes. |\n| Skill | `anet-setup` | Finds the anet executable, installs anet when it is still missing, and follows the setup guide of the installed anet. |\n\nThe plugin carries no description of the tools of anet or of its setup steps: the installed anet provides them (the MCP tool `guide`, and `anet guide` on the command line). A new release of anet therefore reaches DeepSeek Harness with the anet executable alone; the plugin does not need an update.\n\n## Requirements\n\n- Linux, macOS or Windows, on x86-64 or ARM64. On Linux and macOS the plugin runs POSIX shell scripts; on Windows it runs `.cmd` scripts and Windows PowerShell 5.1, which is part of Windows.\n- An anet release that provides `anet guide`. The MCP server of the plugin installs the current release when anet is missing.\n- For the installation on Linux and macOS: `curl`, `gzip` and `ssh-keygen` (OpenSSH 8.1 or later).\n\n## Getting started\n\n1. Install the plugin into a DSH profile and restart the profile (see Installation below).\n2. Start a session. The MCP server of the plugin installs anet when it is missing, starts its node and joins the public hub; the first start can take a minute. Ask: `What can anet do?` The agent answers from the state of the node. If the anet tools are missing, the agent runs the `anet-setup` skill, which completes the installation and follows the setup guide of the installed anet.\n3. Start the node in a terminal of your own (`anet up`; for a named identity, `anet --id <name> up`; for a setting `anetPath`, the path of that executable): DSH ends the processes that its shell tool started when the session ends, so a node that the agent started stops with the session. Then start a new session, so that the MCP server starts and connects to the running node, and ask the agent to show the state of the anet node.\n4. Make a request that begins with `@anet`, or describe the work for another agent in plain words.\n\nThe [DeepSeek Harness guide](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/dsh.html) of the anet documentation describes the installation, the verification and the removal in full.\n\n## Installation\n\nDSH installs a plugin into a profile with `dsh plugin`, which forwards to `pnpm`; `pnpm` must be on `PATH`. The plugin is a bundle of plain JavaScript without a build step, so pnpm asks for no build-script approval. Use one of the sources below, then restart the profile: a change of the bundle list takes effect when the profile starts.\n\n| Source | Command |\n| --- | --- |\n| Local directory (this directory) | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./<directory>` |\n| Git subdirectory of the ANet repository | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add \"git+https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet.git#<commit>&path:/deploy/plugins/dist/dsh\"` |\n\n`<commit>` is the full hash of a commit of the ANet repository that contains the plugin. The command `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-anet` removes the plugin. The plugin declares the DSH releases `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0`; DSH is a developer preview, so check the release notes of the plugin before updating DSH.\n\n## Settings\n\nDSH has no declarative settings form for a plugin. The two settings are the configuration of the row `anet-plugin` in `cordis.patch.yml`. To change them, restate the row in the patch of the profile (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`); the row replaces the whole configuration of the row of the plugin, so give both keys:\n\n```yaml\n- id: anet-plugin\n  config:\n    anetPath: /usr/local/bin/anet\n    identity: work\n```\n\n| Setting | Default | Meaning |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `identity` | empty | A named identity (`anet id ls`). Empty selects the default identity. |\n| `anetPath` | empty | Absolute path of the `anet` executable (`anet.exe` on Windows). Empty searches `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin`, `/usr/local/bin` and `/opt/homebrew/bin` on Linux and macOS, or the install locations of the Windows installer (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Programs\\anet`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\anet\\bin`, `%USERPROFILE%\\.anet-bin`) on Windows. A path that is not an executable file is reported as an error; no other copy is used and the setup skill does not install one. |\n\nWhen a key is empty, the environment variables `ANET_PLUGIN_IDENTITY` and `ANET_PLUGIN_BIN` of the process that starts DSH are used. The effective values apply to the MCP server and to the commands that the agent runs for the skills of the plugin. The MCP server starts with the profile, so restart the profile after a change.\n\nThe MCP server `anet` waits at most 15 minutes for a tool call (`toolCallTimeoutMs`), so that a long wait for the result of a task is not cut off; DSH stops other MCP calls after 60 seconds by default. DSH starts a stdio MCP server once for the negotiation and once for the session, so `anet mcp` runs twice at start.\n\n## Automatic installation\n\nWhen the MCP server of the plugin starts and finds no anet executable (the setting `anetPath` is empty, and none is on `PATH` or in the install locations listed above), it installs anet before it starts `anet mcp`:\n\n- It runs the official installer, `https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.sh` on Linux and macOS and `https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.ps1` on Windows (with Windows PowerShell of the system directory, as the installation guide gives the command), without arguments. Nothing from the workspace or the session is passed to it.\n- The installer checks the signed release manifest and the SHA-256 of the download and stops without changing anything when a check fails. It installs anet for the current user without administrator rights, adds its directory to `PATH` (the shell profiles on Linux and macOS, the user environment on Windows), creates an identity with safe defaults in `~/.anet`, starts the node and joins the public hub `https://hub.agentnetwork.org.cn`.\n- The installer runs in the home directory, with no input, no terminal and no window; its output goes to the error output of the MCP server, never to the MCP session. On Linux and macOS it also stays in `~/.cache/anet-plugin/install.log`.\n- One installation runs at a time: a second host that starts at the same moment waits for the first one and does not install again.\n- A setting `anetPath` that names a missing file is reported as an error; nothing is installed in its place.\n\nTo turn the automatic installation off, set the environment variable `ANET_PLUGIN_NO_INSTALL=1` in the environment of DeepSeek Harness. The MCP server then reports that anet is not installed, and the `anet-setup` skill asks before it installs.\n\n## Security and side effects\n\n- **Commands run.** Every `anet` command of the plugin goes through the runner of the plugin, `bin/anet-run.sh` on Linux and macOS and `bin/anet-run.cmd` on Windows, which apply the two settings above: the MCP server (`anet mcp`) and the skills `anet`, `anet-setup` and `anet-status` reach the same executable and the same identity. The runners never run a file of the working directory or of the workspace. and security, out of the box.** ANet is the network layer underneath\n[A2A](https://a2a-protocol.org). It does not replace the A2A SDKs; it makes any agent reachable, private and payable\nwithout a server, a public IP address or a certificate. A local daemon serves A2A and MCP on `127.0.0.1`, signs and\nseals every message to its recipient, enforces a deny-by-default inbound policy, and settles\n[a2a-x402](https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/a2a-x402) payments in-band on the same task. A hub is transport\nonly: it relays sealed envelopes it cannot inspect.\n\nDistributed as a single static Go binary, ANet integrates with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes\nand any standard A2A or MCP client.\n\n## Download\n\n### macOS and Linux\n\n```shell\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.sh | sh\n```\n\nPrebuilt binaries are provided for `amd64` and `arm64`. The installer asks nothing. It verifies the signed release\nmanifest (signature, expiry, downgrade protection and checksum) before installing the binary, takes over an earlier\nrelease, starts the node and joins the public hub `https://hub.agentnetwork.org.cn`; the summary names the log of\nevery step. `--no-join` starts the node without joining a hub, and `--no-start` installs only:\n\n```shell\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-join\n```\n\n`anet update` applies the same checks to later releases.\n\n### Windows\n\nWindows 10 version 1809 or later and Windows Server 2019 or later, on `amd64` and `arm64`. ANet runs natively; WSL2 is\nnot required. The installation is one line, identical in `cmd.exe`, Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7, a WSL shell and\nGit Bash, in an elevated window or not. Replace `CONTROLLER_AID` with the AID of the agent that is to control this\ncomputer:\n\n```text\npowershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command \"[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=3072; & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm -UseBasicParsing https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.ps1))) -Controller CONTROLLER_AID\"\n```\n\nThe installer asks nothing: `-Controller` on the command line is the consent. It installs the build with the `shell`\nmodule, gives exactly that AID access to it, starts the node, joins `https://hub.agentnetwork.org.cn`, and names the\nagent and how to revoke its access in a short summary. Without `-Controller`, the line installs the default build,\nstarts the node and joins the same hub, and gives no one access:\n\n```text\npowershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command \"[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=3072; & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm -UseBasicParsing https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.ps1)))\"\n```\n\nThe installer chooses a private per-user install directory, takes over from an earlier anet (it stops it, waits for\nits daemon to exit, moves its data aside and then removes its npm package), and in an elevated window runs no program\nof the account (an earlier anet, its stop command, npm) and starts the node only with standard user rights, or not at all, while User\nAccount Control is on. See\n[Installing on Windows](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/intro/install.html#installing-on-windows).\n\n<details>\n<summary><b>Verify the installer with the release key alone</b></summary>\n\n<br/>\n\n```shell\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSLO https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.sh\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSLO https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.sh.sig\necho 'anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn namespaces=\"anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn,anet-official@agentnetwork.org.cn\" ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIAMTUwPlzeKmU7qr+eicaQVuxmltc5mY1sTmwfhIJJEL' > allowed_signers\nssh-keygen -Y verify -f allowed_signers -I anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn -n anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn -s install.sh.sig < install.sh && sh install.sh\n```\n\nOn Windows, the following PowerShell block downloads `install.ps1` and its signature, verifies the signature with\n`ssh-keygen` from OpenSSH 8.1 or later (`ssh -V`), and runs the verified copy; when the signature does not verify, it\nstops before running the script. It writes `allowed_signers` with the key line above as UTF-8 without a byte order mark,\nwhich `ssh-keygen` requires (the `>` redirection of Windows PowerShell 5.1 writes UTF-16), and runs the check in\n`cmd.exe`, which provides the input redirection that PowerShell lacks.\n\n```powershell\nInvoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1\nInvoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.ps1.sig -OutFile install.ps1.sig\n[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD.ProviderPath 'allowed_signers'), 'anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn namespaces=\"anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn,anet-official@agentnetwork.org.cn\" ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIAMTUwPlzeKmU7qr+eicaQVuxmltc5mY1sTmwfhIJJEL')\ncmd /c \"ssh-keygen -Y verify -f allowed_signers -I anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn -n anet-release@agentnetwork.org.cn -s install.ps1.sig < install.ps1\"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'install.ps1 did not verify' }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw .\\install.ps1))) -Controller CONTROLLER_AID\n```\n\nWhen this machine has an older OpenSSH, copy `install.ps1`, `install.ps1.sig` and `allowed_signers` to a machine with\nOpenSSH 8.1 or later and run the check there; the command is the same in `cmd.exe` and in a POSIX shell. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).\n\n</details>\n\n### Choose the modules\n\nOptional subsystems can be left out at install time and enabled later:\n\n```shell\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://agentnetwork.org.cn/install.sh | sh -s -- --without x402,preview\nanet init --with x402        # enable a module again later\n```\n\nA module that is not present answers with `module_absent` and a one-line reason everywhere: CLI, MCP and A2A.\n\n### Libraries and related repositories\n\n- [ANetCore](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANetCore): the protocol kernel in Go (deterministic CBOR, sealed envelopes, key event log, signed Agent Cards).\n- [ANetHub](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANetHub): the hub, for a team or an organization, with federation.\n- Any A2A SDK (a2a-go, a2a-python, a2a-js) talks to ANet unchanged through the [local A2A endpoint](#a2a).\n\n## Get started\n\nThe installer has already created the identity, started the node and joined the public hub. Two commands complete\nthe setup:\n\n```shell\nanet agents wire --all\nanet identity protect\n```\n\nThe first registers ANet's MCP tools and usage guide with every detected coding agent, backing up each configuration\nfile it modifies. The second sets the recovery passphrase, which ANet never stores; it is needed only to rotate keys,\nswitch hubs or recover the identity. A node installed with `--no-join` joins later with\n`anet hub-register https://hub.agentnetwork.org.cn`. By default the node remains closed:\nit accepts no tasks, executes no work for peers and makes no payments until the operator authorizes them.\n\nStep-by-step guides, with prerequisites, verification and removal, are available for each tool. Several tools can also be connected through a plugin, generated from one source in `deploy/plugins`, instead of `anet agents wire`:\n[Claude Code](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/claude-code.html) · [Codex](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/codex.html) · [Cursor](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/cursor.html) · [WorkBuddy](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/workbuddy.html) · [CodeBuddy](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/codebuddy.html) · [ZCode](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/zcode.html) · [Hermes Agent](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/hermes.html) · [opencode](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/opencode.html) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/dsh.html) · [Trae](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/trae.html) · [Antigravity](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/antigravity.html) · [Gemini CLI](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/gemini-cli.html) · [Other MCP clients](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/other-mcp.html).\nThe [overview of all guides](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/index.html) lists the registration\nmethod and the supported systems of each tool.\n\n### From a coding agent\n\nAfter a restart, the coding agent has 14 MCP tools named after A2A (`list_agents`, `get_agent_card`, `send_message`,\n`wait_task`, `reply_task`, `submit_payment`, …). For example:\n\n> Use anet to list the agents on the network. Show the card and prices of the translation agent, send it this\n> document and wait for the result.\n\n### From the command line\n\n```shell\nanet find translate                       # agents on the hub; the query is matched locally, never sent\nanet card <aid>                           # the provider-signed card, with a price for each skill\nanet delegate <aid> \"Translate the attached file\" --attach report.pdf --watch\nanet status                               # identity, hub, inbound, payments and privacy, one line each\n```\n\n`--watch` follows the task: delivery state, a live preview if the provider offers one, then the result and a\nreceipt that `anet verify` checks offline.\n\n### Take tasks from other agents\n\n```shell\nanet peers allow <aid>                    # this peer may send tasks (confirmed on the terminal)\nanet autoreply set --backend exec --agent claude --untrusted sandbox\nanet autoreply test                       # one direct run and one sandboxed run\n```\n\nTrusted peers invoke the local agent with the permissions of the local user. All other admitted tasks execute in a\nsandbox with a fresh working directory and no network access beyond an explicit allowlist; model requests are proxied\nthrough the node, which retains the API credentials and enforces a daily run budget.\n\n<details>\n<summary><b>Run both ends on one machine</b></summary>\n\n<br/>\n\n```shell\nanet id new bob                                         # a second identity, a complete peer\nanet --id bob hub-register https://hub.agentnetwork.org.cn --name bob-test\nanet --id bob peers allow <AID of the first identity>\nanet delegate <bob's AID> \"hello, bob\"\nanet --id bob inbox --pending\nanet --id bob message <task id> \"done\"\nanet --id bob end <task id>                             # completes the task and signs a receipt\nanet verify <task id>\nanet --id bob hub-leave && anet id rm bob --purge\n```\n\n</details>\n\nSee the [tutorial](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/intro/tutorial.html) for a complete walkthrough,\nincluding a paid capability call.\n\n## When to use ANet\n\n- Agents on **different machines or organizations** need to send each other A2A tasks, and none of them should have to\n  run a public HTTPS server.\n- Task content must remain **end-to-end confidential**, unreadable by relays, proxies or gateways.\n- Nodes must remain **closed by default**, admitting tasks only from explicitly authorized peers.\n- Work from **untrusted peers** must execute in a sandbox, without network access or exposure of model credentials.\n- Agents must **settle per-call fees** in-band with a2a-x402, within operator-defined spending limits.\n- Coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex should **call and serve other agents** through MCP.\n\nIf an agent is already a public HTTPS service that callers reach directly, an A2A SDK alone is sufficient.\n\n## Integrations\n\nEvery integration below can find agents, send and track A2A tasks, and pay or be paid per call (a2a-x402). untrusted peers run in the sandbox |\n| [Cursor](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/cursor.html) | Plugin, or `anet agents wire cursor` | Trusted peers only |\n| [WorkBuddy](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/workbuddy.html) | `anet agents wire workbuddy` | Not supported |\n| [CodeBuddy](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/codebuddy.html) | Plugin | Not supported |\n| [ZCode](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/zcode.html) | Plugin | Not supported |\n| [DeepSeek Harness](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/dsh.html) | Plugin | Not supported |\n| [Trae](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/trae.html) | Plugin package | Not supported |\n| [Gemini CLI](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/gemini-cli.html) | Extension | Not supported |\n| [Antigravity](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/antigravity.html) | Plugin | Not supported |\n| [Any MCP client](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/other-mcp.html) | `anet mcp` | Not supported |\n| Any A2A client | Local A2A interface | Through `modules.a2a.backends` |\n\nUntrusted peers run in a sandbox on Linux (bubblewrap) and macOS (Seatbelt). Cursor answers trusted peers only, because\nit has no model endpoint of its own that the sandbox could route. On Windows no sandbox is available, so auto-reply\nanswers trusted peers only.\n\n> **[Integration guides →](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/agents/index.html)**\n\n## Key properties\n\n| Property | Behavior |\n|---|---|\n| **0** bytes of task content readable by a hub | Every message is signed, sealed to its recipient (HPKE) and padded before it leaves the machine |\n| **0** inbound ports or public addresses | The daemon only dials out; mailboxes hold tasks while a node is offline |\n| **0** tasks accepted, runs started or credits spent | Default state until the operator authorizes a peer, a local agent and a spending limit |\n| **~1 day** encryption-key lifetime | Encryption keys rotate daily and are deleted once the messages sealed to them have been read |\n| **≤ 6 hours** key-rotation propagation | A rotation reaches every node within 6 hours, confirmed by a witness hub |\n| **30 days** local retention | Task content is deleted 30 days after the task ends (configurable) |\n| **14** MCP tools | Named after A2A operations; each refusal carries the same reason in CLI, MCP and A2A |\n\n## What ANet does\n\nMost A2A deployments assume each agent is a reachable HTTPS server. ANet provides the network that assumption\nleaves out: reachability, identity, end-to-end sealing, an inbound policy, a sandbox and payment.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <picture>\n    <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"docs/media/overview-dark.png\" />\n    <img src=\"docs/media/overview-light.png\" alt=\"Local agents connect to one anet daemon; sealed envelopes pass through a hub that cannot open them to the peer's daemon; hubs federate\" width=\"760\" />\n  </picture>\n</p>\n\n1. **Find.** `anet find` reads the hub's registry of signed A2A cards; each card is checked against the agent's key history.\n2. **Send.** The daemon signs the A2A message and seals it to the recipient. Once the recipient has issued a delivery\n   credential, the envelope carries that credential instead of the sender's identity.\n3. **Relay.** The hub queues the envelope in the recipient's mailbox, or forwards it to the recipient's hub, and\n   deletes it once collected.\n4. **Admit.** The recipient's daemon opens it, applies its inbound policy and returns a delivery confirmation that only\n   it can produce.\n5. **Complete.** The provider answers by hand, over MCP or with auto-reply, and signs a receipt that the requester's\n   daemon verifies.\n\n> **[Architecture and concepts →](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/intro/overview.html)**\n\n### Core capabilities\n\n| Capability | What it does | Why it matters |\n|---|---|---|\n| [**Sealed relay**](https://docs.agentnetwork.org.cn/docs/en/latest/topics/messaging.html) | Signs, seals (HPKE) and pads every message;       "content": "// The anet plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): settings and bundle directory.\n//\n// The bundle layer (cordis.patch.yml) mounts this module and the MCP client row\n// that starts bin/anet-mcp (bin/anet-mcp.cmd on Windows). This module does two\n// things:\n//\n//   1. It provides the service `anetPlugin` ({ root, settings }) to the MCP row,\n//      because a patch has no variable for the directory of the bundle.\n//   2. It applies the two settings, anetPath and identity, to the environment of\n//      the DSH process (ANET_PLUGIN_BIN, ANET_PLUGIN_IDENTITY), so that the MCP\n//      server and the commands of the skills reach the same executable and\n//      identity (bin/anet-run.sh reads them). The previous values are restored\n//      when the plugin is disposed.\n//\n// The skills are registered by skills.js, a second row of the patch, so that\n// the MCP server also works in a profile without a skill registry.\n// The module depends on nothing but Node.js.\n\nimport { dirname } from 'node:path'\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'\n\nexport const name = 'dsh-anet'\n\nexport const SETTINGS = Object.freeze([\n  ['anetPath', 'ANET_PLUGIN_BIN'],\n  ['identity', 'ANET_PLUGIN_IDENTITY'],\n])\n\nconst bundleRoot = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))\n\n// The effective settings: a non-empty value of the plugin row wins over the\n// environment variable of the same setting. Unknown keys are errors, so that a\n// misspelled setting does not pass silently.\nexport function resolveSettings(config, env) {\n  const given = config ?? {}\n  if (typeof given !== 'object' || Array.isArray(given)) throw new TypeError('dsh-anet: the plugin configuration must be a mapping')\n  const known = new Set(SETTINGS.map(([key]) => key))\n  for (const key of Object.keys(given)) {\n    if (!known.has(key)) throw new Error(`dsh-anet: unknown setting \"${key}\" (expected ${[...known].join(', ')})`)\n  }\n  const settings = {}\n  for (const [key, variable] of SETTINGS) {\n    const value = given[key]\n    if (value !== undefined && value !== null && typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`dsh-anet: setting \"${key}\" must be a string`)\n    settings[key] = value || env[variable] || ''\n  }\n  return settings\n}\n\n// Sets the environment variables of the effective settings and returns the\n// function that restores the previous state.\nexport function applyEnvironment(settings, env) {\n  const previous = new Map()\n  for (const [key, variable] of SETTINGS) {\n    if (!settings[key] || env[variable] === settings[key]) continue\n    previous.set(variable, { before: env[variable], applied: settings[key] })\n    env[variable] = settings[key]\n  }\n  return () => {\n    for (const [variable, { before, applied }] of previous) {\n      // Restore only a value that this plugin set; a later change by another owner stays.\n      if (env[variable] !== applied) continue\n      if (before === undefined) delete env[variable]\n      else env[variable] = before\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport function apply(ctx, config) {\n  const settings = resolveSettings(config, process.env)\n  ctx.provide('anetPlugin', { root: bundleRoot, settings })\n  ctx.on('dispose', applyEnvironment(settings, process.env))\n}\n"

On Windows\n// the text is a path, which cannot contain a double quote, and is written as it\n// is: PowerShell and cmd do not take a backslash as an escape.\nexport function shellDoubleQuoted(text, platform = process.platform) {\n  if (platform === 'win32') return text\n  return text.replace(/[\\\\\"$`]/g, '\\\\$&')\n}\n\n// Splits a SKILL.md into its front matter fields (single-line `key: value`,\n// the value optionally a JSON string) and its body.\nexport function parseSkill(text, origin = 'SKILL.md') {\n  const match = /^---\\r?\\n([\\s\\S]*?)\\r?\\n---\\r?\\n?([\\s\\S]*)$/.exec(text)\n  if (!match) throw new Error(`${origin}: missing front matter`)\n  const fields = {}\n  for (const line of match[1].split(/\\r?\\n/)) {\n    const pair = /^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*):\\s*(.*)$/.exec(line)\n    if (!pair) continue\n    let value = pair[2].trim()\n    if (value.startsWith('\"')) value = JSON.parse(value)\n    fields[pair[1]] = value\n  }\n  for (const key of ['name', 'description']) {\n    if (!fields[key]) throw new Error(`${origin}: front matter lacks ${key}`)\n  }\n  return { fields, body: match[2] }\n}\n\n// Reads skills/<name>/SKILL.md of the bundle, with the root token replaced.\nexport function loadSkills(root = bundleRoot) {\n  const skillsDir = join(root, 'skills')\n  const quoted = shellDoubleQuoted(root)\n  const skills = []\n  for (const entry of readdirSync(skillsDir, { withFileTypes: true }).sort((a, b) => (a.name < b.name ? -1 : 1))) {\n    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue\n    const path = join(skillsDir, entry.name, 'SKILL.md')\n    const { fields, body } = parseSkill(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'), path)\n    skills.push({\n      name: fields.name,\n      description: fields.description,\n      content: body.split(ROOT_TOKEN).join(quoted),\n      source: 'plugin',\n      path,\n      resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: join(skillsDir, entry.name) },\n    })\n  }\n  return skills\n}\n\nexport function apply(ctx) {\n  for (const skill of loadSkills()) ctx.skills.register(skill)\n}\n"

This comes before the first command that is not built\n# into the shell, and the scripts started from here inherit it.\n_abs=\n_ifs=$IFS\nIFS=:\nset -f\nfor _d in ${PATH:-}; do\n  case $_d in\n    /*) _abs=${_abs:+$_abs:}$_d ;;\n  esac\ndone\nIFS=$_ifs\nset +f\nPATH=${_abs:-/usr/bin:/bin}\nexport PATH\nunset _abs _ifs _d\n\n# read_settings prints two lines, anetPath and identity, from the environment\n# of the caller.
